idea-plugin.name: Tide Pets
idea-plugin.description:
Tide Pets — sea creatures that keep you company while you code

A pet swims up and down the right edge of your editor, out of the way of your code, and reacts to what you do. Pick one: Shelly the sea turtle, Bloop the jellyfish, Inky the octopus, Pinchy the crab, Puff the pufferfish, Blue the whale, Clem the clownfish, Sandy the seahorse, Finn the shark, Splash the dolphin, Angie the angelfish or Indigo the blue tang.

  • Typing — swims faster
  • Saving — a happy loop and a few bubbles
  • New errors in the open file — looks worried, and hides when a lot appear at once (the octopus inks, the pufferfish puffs up)
  • Errors fixed — celebrates
  • Run configurations — spins when the app starts, cheers when a run passes, hides when it fails
  • AI assistants — notices when you open Copilot, AI Assistant, Junie and friends, and when a big block of code appears at once
  • The terminal — says hello when you open it
  • Branches and undo — notices a new branch, and a run of undos
  • Late nights, mornings, long sessions — says so, and suggests a stretch
  • Debugging — brings out a magnifying glass
  • Switching files — looks around
  • Idle for a few minutes — naps
  • Clicked / double-clicked — does a spin / shows hearts

Feed it: right-click the pet and choose Feed Pet, and a { }, [ ], ( ), < > or ; sinks down for it to eat. Every 20th { you type drops a crumb too.

The pet swims up and down a strip at the editor's right edge, beside the scrollbar; you can move it to the bottom edge instead. Drag it to where it should stay, or let it swim. It only takes clicks on itself, and when your cursor is right beside it, it fades and lets your clicks through. Right-click it to feed it, choose a pet or an edge, or hide it; Settings → Tools → Tide Pets sets its position, size and name.

Made to go with the Midnight Tide theme, and works with any theme.

Free and open source (MIT): github.com/Chelayel/tide-pets.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.3.0 — The pet now swims up and down the editor's right edge, out of the way of your code (the bottom edge is still an option, in its menu or the settings). Three new pets: Splash the dolphin, Angie the angelfish and Indigo the blue tang.

0.2.1 — Fix: the pet could end up underneath the editor and disappear (its layer was set as a list position). New screenshot of the pet in IntelliJ IDEA.

0.2.0 — Eight new pets: Bloop the jellyfish, Inky the octopus, Pinchy the crab, Puff the pufferfish, Blue the whale, Clem the clownfish, Sandy the seahorse and Finn the shark. Feed your pet curly braces; it reacts to AI assistants, the terminal, runs, branches, undo sprees and the time of day. The pet now floats at the bottom of the editor instead of living in a tool window: drag it where you want it, or let it swim around; it fades out of the way of the line you're working on. Right-click it or use Tools → Tide Pets to choose one; Settings → Tools → Tide Pets for its size and name. New logo.

0.1.1 — First release on the Marketplace (0.1.0 was built but not uploaded).

0.1.0 — First release: Shelly the sea turtle.
